top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes the most mature and unified proposed achievement: the integration of firm heterogeneity and endogenous selection into trade analysis, connecting firm productivity, reallocation, and aggregate gains. Melitz is foundational, while Helpman and Redding have defensible complementary claims under a tightly bounded citation that does not claim credit for the whole heterogeneous-firm literature.
recusal_note: No direct conflict with the proposed laureates is apparent from the supplied profile. I disclose frequent coauthorship with committee colleagues Per Krusell and John Hassler, and longstanding collaboration with Peter J. Klenow, who is not included in any proposal.
